newsitem.title: USA: Fisher stake lifted by Bass family.
newsitem.headline: Fisher stake lifted by Bass family.

text.p: A group led by the Bass Family of Fort Worth, Texas said Thursday it raised it stake in Fisher Scientific International to 1,767,835 common shares or 8.8 percent from 7.6 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 221,900 common shares bought between November 26 and January 22 at prices ranging from $42.56 to $47.45 per share.
The group previously held 1,511,400 common shares or 7.6 percent of the outstanding.
Fisher, based on Hampton, New Hampshire, is a supplier of scientific instruments, supplies and equipment to the scientific community in North America.
